summary: POSCO Holdings filed a 6-K disclosing board approval to dispose of 23,385,917 common shares of affiliated POS DX, an IT services subsidiary, via after-hours block trade or OTC, reducing its stake from 65.4% to 50.0%. Disposal amount is KRW 481.75 billion (~KRW 20,600/share), based on the prior closing price, with no stated premium. A 3-year price return swap will settle any difference between reference price and actual disposal value. Purpose: reduce holding company discount and fund strategic investments. Scheduled disposal date is 2026-09-07; no options or break fee were mentioned. Watch: execution risk from price volatility and post-deal overhang of the remaining 50% stake.
